asset.Name: Finance x3
asset.Description:
Triples the base monthly funding of every funding region. A gentler alternative to Finance x10: more room for mistakes and base building without making money irrelevant.

MONTHLY BASE FUNDING
- North America: $660,000 (was $220,000)
- Soviet Union: $660,000 (was $220,000)
- Western Europe: $480,000 (was $160,000)
- Asia Pacific: $480,000 (was $160,000)
- Africa & Middle East: $330,000 (was $110,000)
- Latin America: $330,000 (was $110,000)

Only the flat part of the funding is changed; the bonus from regional relations works as in the base game.

COMPATIBILITY
- Replaces the six region templates: do not use together with Finance x10 or any mod that edits the same files.
asset.Author: andreacw96
